notes.title: Patch 1.2.7.2
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the game failing to launch properly. By default it will now start in windowed mode at full screen resolution. Full screen mode is still accessible using the in-game setting.
Fixed a crash when player was attempting to build a road without having any colonies.

notes.title: Version 1.2.7
notes.notes:
Version changelog:
[list]
[*] Added ability to view market prices without having a ship in Europe - added a new button in the colony screen, on the world map the window can be accessed using F2 key
[*] Display the free storage capacity in the colony screen as number
[*] Added the option to continue playing after the end game score is saved
[*] Improved units pathfinding
[*] Fixed a bug with naturalist's "Live among the natives" option
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Version changelog:
[list]
[*] In "sell resources" missions, only ask for resources that are available in player's colonies
[*] "Kill pirate" mission also counts as succeeded if the target is killed or captured by other country
[*] For "explore ruins" missions reveal unexplored ruins near player settlements
[*] Increased time to complete missions (+20% more turns)
[*] Limit trade with natives to simulate limited trade goods
[*] Prevent native settlements or AI colonies to be built over ruins
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.5
notes.notes:
[h1]New Feature: Treasure Maps[/h1]
[h3]Hunt down pirates and grab their treasure maps. Find the location to fill your coffers with gold.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452651/971990c937d031ab1758d8a6509ca4229354a028.png[/img]

Version changelog:
[list]
[*] Pirate ships can drop treasure maps.
[*] Can clear specialist unit's profession in home port.
[*] Added hotkeys list to in-game Encyclopaedia.
[*] Another fix for labor allocation in colonies.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed a natives reaction bug which presented a hostile reaction instead of friendly
[*] more consistent natives reaction when interacting with player's units
[*] roaming native units can only trade once before returning to their home villages
[*] optimized labor allocation when specialist units raced for the same labor position
[*] reorganized production information of overview window
[/list]
